newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland Bank gov sees stable growth, no overheating.
newsitem.headline: Finland Bank gov sees stable growth, no overheating.

text.p: Bank of Finland governor Sirkka Hamalainen was quoted as saying in a newspaper interview published on Wednesday that Finnish economic growth was steady without any signs of overheating.
"The economy is growing steadily without any signs of overheating," Hamalainen said in Swedish business daily FinansTidningen.
"The most important reasons for the good economic development are low pay rises, a disciplined fiscal policy and a clear increase in corporate sector productivity," she said.
"So far, exports have been the driving force but now consumption, too, has started to increase. Construction has got under way, as have corporate investments," she said.
FinansTidningen did not quote Hamalainen as saying anything about inflation or monetary policy. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
